calculation_handling.description: A transitional application must provide accessible parking spaces in compliance with 200.15.15.4 and 200.15.15.5.

200.15.15(1).explanation: An application submitted before May 26, 2017 that is eligible to proceed under Clauses 200.15.15.1 to 200.15.15.3 must provide accessible parking spaces as required by 200.15.15.4 and 200.15.15.5.
